headline: Microsoft launches Scout, an OpenClaw-inspired personal assistant, while Uber caps employee AI spending after blowing through budget in 4 months
tldr: Today in AI, Microsoft unveiled its new personal assistant, Scout, inspired by OpenClaw, and Uber had to cap employee AI spending after exceeding its budget. Meanwhile, OpenAI launched new Codex tools for white-collar work, and Anthropic expanded its security vulnerability program. These developments highlight the rapid growth and adoption of AI across industries, with companies investing in AI-powered tools and services to improve productivity and efficiency. However, they also raise concerns about the responsible use of AI and the need for effective management and regulation.

new_models.title: Microsoft launches Scout, an OpenClaw-inspired personal assistant
new_models.summary: Microsoft launched Scout, a new AI assistant inspired by OpenClaw, to bring its power and flexibility into the Microsoft 365 system.
new_models.why_it_matters: This launch highlights Microsoft's efforts to integrate AI into its products and services, making it more accessible to users.

new_models.title: OpenAI launches new Codex tools for white-collar work
new_models.summary: OpenAI released six new Codex tools aimed at specific white-collar jobs, such as data analytics and sales, to help users approximate tasks.
new_models.why_it_matters: These tools demonstrate OpenAI's focus on developing AI-powered solutions for various industries and professions.

features_updates.title: Microsoft offers devs a better way to control AI agent behavior
features_updates.summary: Microsoft introduced a new specification that allows developers to define policies for AI agents to follow, improving control and security.
features_updates.why_it_matters: This update demonstrates Microsoft's commitment to providing developers with more control over AI agents, enhancing their usability and reliability.

features_updates.summary: Hugging Face announced Holo3.1, a new version of its computer use agents, focusing on speed and local usage.

industry_business.title: Uber caps employee AI spending after blowing through budget in 4 months
industry_business.summary: Uber had to cap employee AI spending after exceeding its budget in just four months, highlighting the rapid adoption of AI in the company.
industry_business.why_it_matters: This news illustrates the challenges companies face in managing AI spending and the need for effective budgeting and resource allocation.

industry_business.title: ZeroDrift raises $10M to protect AI models from themselves
industry_business.summary: ZeroDrift raised $10M to develop an AI compliance service that flags and replaces non-compliant messages from AI models.
industry_business.why_it_matters: This funding round highlights the growing concern about AI model safety and the need for solutions to mitigate potential risks.

industry_business.title: NVIDIA Partners With Microsoft on Unified Stack for Agentic AI Deployment
industry_business.summary: NVIDIA and Microsoft partnered to create a unified stack for agentic AI deployment, covering Windows devices, cloud, and local environments.
industry_business.why_it_matters: This partnership demonstrates the collaboration between industry leaders to develop comprehensive AI solutions, facilitating wider adoption.
